context.name: Jezero Crater · Perseverance landing site (Octavia E. Butler)

grid.dataset: MRO HiRISE DTM DTEEC_045994_1985_046060_1985_U01 (Univ. of Arizona / USGS, 1 m/px)

rock.method: Ellipsoid envelope: V = pi × length × width × height / 6; mass = volume × assumed density. Axes are full diameters.

scale.meaning: Samples across the smaller horizontal axis use the coarser of native resolution and grid spacing. Three samples across is an editorial survey-planning target, not a detection or accuracy guarantee; no feature was detected.

rock.next: Acquire calibrated stereo/lidar dimensions and a material/density measurement. Compare obstacle geometry with a validated rover model before planning a crossing.
rock.limitation: An ellipsoid is a geometric envelope, not measured rock shape or total buried volume. Density bounds and axis uncertainty are operator assumptions. Mass bounds are conditional on those inputs; unknown dimensional uncertainty is not zero. Clearance ratio is not traversability.

cavity.method: Elliptical opening: A = pi × length × width / 4. Vertical cylindrical pit envelope: V = A × depth. A pit is not the connected cave.

scale.meaning: Samples across the smaller horizontal axis use the coarser of native resolution and grid spacing. Three samples across is an editorial survey-planning target, not a detection or accuracy guarantee; no feature was detected.

cavity.next: Obtain local stereo/lidar and subsurface/structural evidence; establish access geometry and survey requirements before selecting a shelter or descent operation.
cavity.limitation: Volume is a cylindrical geometric envelope, not surveyed capacity, shelter area or subsurface extent. Ideal drop time assumes rest and constant gravity, without drag; it is an illustrative comparison, not a descent design. Roof, access, ice and shielding remain unknown.

reference.name: Marius Hills pit · LROC Pit Atlas
reference.definition: Inner pit diameters and stereo-derived depth; not the larger funnel or a mapped connected cave volume. Published uncertainty is unavailable.

limitation: Planning estimates only. Regional DEMs do not detect individual rocks or underground voids. Geometry does not establish composition, connected cave extent, roof stability, access or route safety.
